title: Arthur742Ramos/finite-graph-fundamental-group
abstract: Formalizes the fundamental group of a finite connected graph, represented as a finite weakly connected directed multigraph with its standard interval-cell quotient realization. The main result identifies the topological fundamental group at a chosen vertex with `FreeGroup (Fin (E + 1 - V))`. The proof compares the topological group with the endomorphism group at the root in Mathlib's free groupoid, whose explicit spanning-tree basis supplies the non-tree-edge generators. The development also proves the cycle-rank identities, root-change equivalences, the tree/triviality criterion, and the corresponding abelianization statement. It constructs a path-lifting quiver and verifies its covering property; the realization of that cover is proved contractible by an explicit quotient homotopy, and path lifting plus monodromy completes the comparison isomorphism.
